content.title: Track and withdraw a manuscript submission
content.description: An author views the submissions currently held for that browser session, sees each submission’s reference, book title, author, package, seat, and status, and can withdraw a submission to remove it from the table, restore the claimed onboarding seat to the shared monthly pool, and keep the `My Submissions (N)` header count aligned with the current session state.
content.value: Gives authors self-serve visibility into current submissions and a way to release scarce seat capacity.
criteria: With nothing submitted, `/my-submissions` shows `You haven't submitted a manuscript yet.` and links the user back to browse packages.
After submitting, `/my-submissions` lists each submission in a table with the columns Reference, Book Title, Author, Package, Seat, and Status.
A new submission’s status is `Under Review`.
The header `My Submissions (N)` count matches the number of rows in the submissions table.
Each submission row offers a `Withdraw` control that removes that row from the table.
Withdrawing a submission returns its seat to the pool, so the package’s remaining seat count on `/publish` goes back up by one.
Submission tracking is scoped to the browser session rather than an account.
